name: signal-audit-frontend-fixture
card_schema: signal_review_card@1.0.0 + signal_llm_review@2.1.0 side_evidence_ratings + signal_llm_review@2.0.0 readable + signal_rating@1.0.0 legacy-readable + nrd.signal.durability_layer.v1
manifest_schema: signal_cards_manifest@1.0.0 + signal_evidence_summary@2.1.0 display projection + signal_evidence_summary@2.0.0 readable-only + legacy signal_comfort_summary readable-only
fixture_policy: committed signal_cards are local preview fixtures; default deploy fixtures exclude synthetic cards; production cards are generated on the server from FMZ signal_review.jsonl and optional LLM sidecar
frontend_contract: HTTP mode fetches signal_cards/index.json first, renders manifest summary cards using signal_evidence_summary as the list stat, keeps chronological order, supports B及以上 and A/S filters only for v2 evidence grades, lazy-loads selected signal_cards/*.json with memory cache and two-card prefetch isolation, then shows one Chinese reader path for v2 cards: action summary and local action state, card-time market price, independent LLM price bias, Put/Call evidence grades, optional validated side comparison, adopted side theses and mechanism, spatial geometry and conditional gamma feedback, verified changes with explicit unavailable reasons, counter/alternative explanations, strengthen/weaken next conditions, complete Chinese numeric facts, and a download-only full audit JSON entry. V2 pages do not render legacy integrated advisory, old LLM deep panels, old confidence/durability totals, 24-hour long report, raw field paths, schema, hashes, formulas, weights, or machine enum fallbacks. Legacy comfort cards remain readable as historical action ratings and are excluded from v2 B及以上/A-S filters.
reader_presentation: User-selected neutral paper style with v2.1 compact decision summary; same report layout, module order and semantic colors, quiet evidence links, tabular figures and visible keyboard focus. Local stage freeze; no model, producer or FMZ version change.
